content: We have carbon NMR shifts: list includes 8 carbons. Need number of CH3 groups. CH3 carbons typically around 10-30 ppm for aliphatic methyls, but here we have 43.47 and 38.60 (likely methyl attached to something like carbonyl? maybe isopropyl?). Also aromatic carbons around 120-140 ppm. So only aliphatic carbons are 43.47 and 38.60. Both could be CH3 or CH2. Need to determine number of methyl groups. Could use proton NMR to see methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
